name: The Magnet - First Night
source:
"First night" is the first chapter in "the magnet" series that follows Teddie, a young girl who is trying to survive the end of the world.

Teddie is a strong willed and independent girl who has to weather the storms of being survival and how to deal with other people now that the world has been overtaken by creatures known only as "the horrors"

[Edited from [url=https://artyfartygames.itch.io/the-magnet-first-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“第一夜”是《The Magnet》系列的首章，跟随少女泰迪讲述她努力在世界末日中生存下去的故事。

泰迪意志坚强，独立自主。如今，世界已被仅被称为“恐怖之物”的生物占据，她必须熬过生存的艰难，也要学会如何与其他人相处。

[编译自[url=https://artyfartygames.itch.io/the-magnet-first-night]itch.io[/url]]
